facts.business: Cosco (India) Limited manufactures and trades in sports goods and fitness equipment.

auditor.name: Madan & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on multiple notes including advance of Rs 28.63 lakhs with shipping companies, valuation of work in progress and stores, recoverability of trade receivables of Rs 55.34 lakhs, non-translation of export trade receivables of Rs 97.50 lakhs, confirmation of trade receivables, comparative analysis of prepaid expenses of Rs 46.75 lakhs, advance against imports of Rs 114.37 lakhs, non-confirmation of advance to suppliers of Rs 19.52 lakhs, change in accounting policy for warranty claims, confirmation of trade payables, provision of bonus of Rs 93.01 lakhs, and unconfirmed advance from customers.

key_risks: Unconfirmed advances with shipping companies (Rs 28.64 lakhs)
Valuation uncertainties for work in progress and stores
Non-translation of export trade receivables (Rs 97.50 lakhs)
Non-confirmation of trade receivables and advances to suppliers (Rs 19.52 lakhs)
Advance against imports (Rs 114.37 lakhs) and prepaid expenses (Rs 46.75 lakhs) requiring verification
Change in accounting policy for warranty claims
Legal dispute over advance for immovable properties (Rs 126.24 lakhs) pending since 2013
Internal audit system needs substantial strengthening
Quarterly internal audit reports produced close to signing of audit report
Discrepancies in quarterly returns filed with banks for trade receivables and inventory
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable and details have been disclosed vide note 34 in the standalone financial statements as required under Ind AS 24.
